# Project Guidelines — stonefishy.github.io

Hexo static blog (v6) with [hexo-theme-bamboo](../themes/hexo-theme-bamboo/) (v3.2.9).  
Site: https://stonefishy.github.io | Source: `source/_posts/` | Output: `public/`

## Build & Test

```bash
npm run server    # local dev server at http://localhost:4000
npm run build     # hexo generate → public/
npm run clean     # clear public/ and db.json
npm run deploy    # hexo deploy (requires deploy config in _config.yml)
```

> `public/` and `node_modules/` should never be committed.

## Content Conventions

**New posts** go in `source/_posts/` with the filename pattern:

```
YYYY-MM-DD-kebab-case-title.md
```

Use `.md` extension only (not `.markdown`).

**Required front matter:**

```yaml
---
title: 'Post Title Here'
date: 2026-04-03 10:00:00
categories: Backend        # singular noun, one only — see list below
tags: [Tag1, Tag2]         # array style
---
```

- **categories**: `AI`, `Backend`, `Frontend`, `Mobile`, `Others`, `Resources`, `Testing`, `Tools`, `中间件`, `云计算`, `大数据`, `数据库`, `算法`, `设计模式`
- **tags**: Arrays `[Tag1, Tag2]`; match existing tag names exactly (case-sensitive)
- **Excerpts**: Place `<!--more-->` after the intro paragraph to control the index preview
- **Math**: KaTeX/MathJax is enabled — use standard LaTeX delimiters `$…$` / `$$…$$`

## Architecture

| Path | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `_config.yml` | Site-level config (URL, permalink, plugins) |
| `themes/hexo-theme-bamboo/_config.yml` | Theme UI config (menu, sidebar, social) |
| `source/_posts/` | All blog posts (229+, 2013-2025) |
| `source/assets/` | Post images and custom assets |
| `source/medias/` | Site-wide media (avatar, backgrounds) |
| `scaffolds/post.md` | Default front matter template for new posts |

Permalink format: `/:year/:month/:day/:title/` — Chinese titles are auto-converted to pinyin via `hexo-permalink-pinyin`.

## Conventions

- **Do not edit** `public/` — it is fully regenerated by `npm run build`
- Theme customizations belong in `themes/hexo-theme-bamboo/_config.yml`, not in `_config.yml`
- `_config.landscape.yml` is an unused leftover — ignore it
- The deploy target (`_config.yml → deploy:`) is intentionally left unconfigured in the repo
